10k.note: Combined commercial medtech (TriNav PEDD device family, FDA-cleared, $45.2M FY2025 revenue) plus investigational drug nelitolimod (TLR9 agonist, acquired from Dynavax 2020). Three Phase 1/1b PERIO studies; results expected 2026; planning pharma partnership for further development.

website.note: Public pipeline page documents nelitolimod PERIO-01/02/03 program and TriNav device line.

pipeline.modality: Class C TLR9 agonist (oligonucleotide); delivered intratumorally via Pressure-Enabled Drug Delivery (PEDD)
pipeline.target: TLR9; reduces myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) in liver/pancreas tumor microenvironment
pipeline.license_origin: Acquired from Dynavax (Asset Purchase Agreement, July 31, 2020); $9M paid upfront/reimbursement plus $3M milestones to date; up to $170M development and $80M commercial milestones; tiered 10-12% royalty on net sales

indications.trial_design: Phase 1, intrapancreatic pressure-enabled delivery of SD-101 (nelitolimod) plus anti-PD-1 checkpoint blockade in locally advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma; lead investigator MD Anderson Cancer Center
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (started 2023-03-01; primary completion 2027-09); results expected 2026
key_milestones: Subsequent indication selection and pharma partnership discussions planned

indications.trial_name: Cryoablation + PEDD-delivered SD-101 with durvalumab + tremelimumab
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 investigator-initiated trial (IIT) of cryotherapy plus arterial pressure-enabled infusion of nelitolimod combined with durvalumab and tremelimumab in HCC; TriSalus drug supply / collaborator
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (started 2025-01-03; primary completion 2027-06); 10-K notes HCC investigation continuing through IIT after company-sponsored PERIO-02 was terminated
indications.lead_sponsor: University of California, San Diego (TriSalus collaborator and drug provider)
key_milestones: IIT data expected to inform HCC indication selection alongside PERIO-03 PDAC readout

commercial_product.device_family: TriNav / TriNav XP — Pressure-Enabled Drug Delivery (PEDD) microcatheters
commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k)-cleared; used in over 31,000 procedures (TACE/TARE primarily); FY2025 revenue $45.2M (+53.4% YoY)
commercial_product.additional_uses: Off-label / emerging procedural applications in uterine artery embolization, thyroid artery embolization, prostate artery embolization, genicular artery embolization (osteoarthritis)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Terminated (primary completion 2024-07-31); HCC interest continues via UCSD IIT NCT06710223

excluded_legacy_terminated.asset: PEDD pancreatic retrograde venous infusion (FOLFIRI/FOLFIRINOX) — Roger Williams investigator study
Pembrolizumab +/- SD-101 in oligometastatic prostate cancer (David Oh, UCSF, IIT)
excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Completed Phase 2 IIT (primary completion 2025-03-31); TriSalus listed as collaborator only; no active sponsor-led prostate program disclosed in 10-K
